abbott_smith_html:
προφητεύω
(προφήτης), [in LXX chiefly for נָבָא ni., hith. ;]
to be a προφήτης (which see), to prophesy: in the primary sense of telling forth the Divine counsels, Mat.7:22 26:68, Mrk.14:65, Luk.1:67 22:64, Act.19:6, 1Co.11:4-5 13:9 14:1 14:3-5 14:24 14:31 14:39, Heb.11:3; with the idea of foretelling future events (an idea merely incidental, not essential; see Lft., Notes, 83 f.), Mat.11:13, Act.2:17-18" (LXX) Act.21:9; before περί, Mat.15:7, Mrk.7:6, 1Pe.1:10; ἐπί, with dative, Rev.10:11; λέγων, Ju 14; ὅτι, Jhn.11:51.†
SYN.: μαντεύομαι, q.v (AS)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to foretell events, divine, speak under inspiration, exercise the prophetic office

lxx_note: [in LXX chiefly for נָבָא ni., hith. ;]

occurrences.bsb: Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and in Your name drive out demons and perform many miracles?’
occurrences.kjv: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?

occurrences.bsb: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.
occurrences.kjv: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

occurrences.bsb: You hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied correctly about you:
occurrences.kjv: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,

occurrences.bsb: and said, “Prophesy to us, Christ! Who hit You?”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered them, “Isaiah prophesied correctly about you hypocrites, as it is written: ‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.
occurrences.kjv: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

occurrences.bsb: Then some of them began to spit on Him. They blindfolded Him, struck Him with their fists, and said to Him, “Prophesy!” And the officers received Him with slaps in His face.
occurrences.kjv: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.

occurrences.bsb: Then his father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied:
occurrences.kjv: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,

occurrences.bsb: They blindfolded Him and kept demanding, “Prophesy! Who hit You?”
occurrences.kjv: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?

occurrences.bsb: Caiaphas did not say this on his own. Instead, as high priest that year, he was prophesying that Jesus would die for the nation,
occurrences.kjv: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;

occurrences.bsb: ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.
occurrences.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:

occurrences.bsb: Even on My menservants and maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.
occurrences.kjv: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:

occurrences.bsb: And when Paul laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came upon them, and they spoke in tongues and prophesied.
occurrences.kjv: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.

occurrences.bsb: He had four unmarried daughters who prophesied.
occurrences.kjv: And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.

occurrences.bsb: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.
occurrences.kjv: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.

occurrences.bsb: And every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, for it is just as if her head were shaved.
occurrences.kjv: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.

occurrences.bsb: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,
occurrences.kjv: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.

occurrences.bsb: Earnestly pursue love and eagerly desire spiritual gifts, especially the gift of prophecy.
occurrences.kjv: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.

occurrences.bsb: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, encouragement, and comfort.
occurrences.kjv: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.

occurrences.bsb: The one who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but the one who prophesies edifies the church.
occurrences.kjv: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.

occurrences.bsb: I wish that all of you could speak in tongues, but I would rather have you prophesy. He who prophesies is greater than one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets so that the church may be edified.
occurrences.kjv: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.

occurrences.bsb: But if an unbeliever or uninstructed person comes in while everyone is prophesying, he will be convicted and called to account by all,
occurrences.kjv: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:

occurrences.bsb: For you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged.
occurrences.kjv: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.

occurrences.bsb: So, my brothers, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.

occurrences.bsb: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who foretold the grace to come to you searched and investigated carefully,
occurrences.kjv: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:

occurrences.bsb: Enoch, the seventh from Adam, also prophesied about them: “Behold, the Lord is coming with myriads of His holy ones
occurrences.kjv: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,

occurrences.bsb: And they told me, “You must prophesy again about many peoples and nations and tongues and kings.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto me, Thou must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.

occurrences.bsb: And I will empower my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth.”
occurrences.kjv: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.
